summary: Tested Ritme Forgot Password (OTP via email) feature — backend endpoints (9 pytest cases, 100% pass) and frontend flow (navigation, step 1→2, password mismatch, change-email, resend, happy-path E2E reset + login). Found and fixed one critical import bug in App.js that would have prevented the /lupa-sandi route from loading.

minor.issue: When email service call fails, endpoint returns 502 leaking that the email exists — breaks anti-enumeration invariant. Suggest: catch exception, log, and still return generic 200. Currently registered-email path leaks via 502 when Resend has issues.

action_items: OPTIONAL (security hardening): In /api/auth/forgot-password, swallow email-send exceptions and always return the generic 200 message so that an email-service failure does not enable user enumeration.
Consider adding a client-side password strength/mismatch inline hint in ForgotPasswordPage step 2 (currently only shown on submit via toast — works but late feedback).
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL (FIXED by tester): /app/frontend/src/App.js referenced <ForgotPasswordPage /> without importing it — would have crashed the SPA. Added `import ForgotPasswordPage from "@/pages/ForgotPasswordPage";`.
Security: password_resets.otp_hash correctly stored as bcrypt hash (verified via direct DB inspection). No plaintext OTP anywhere.
Anti-enumeration: unregistered email correctly returns generic 200. However registered email path can raise 502 on email-send failure, which is an enumeration side-channel.
Rate limit: 5 wrong attempts then 6th → 429 + record marked used ✓
Single-use: used OTP cannot be replayed ✓
Invalidation: new forgot-password request marks previous unused records used=true ✓
Expiry: expired OTP correctly rejected with 400 'kedaluwarsa' ✓
reset-password after wrong OTP correctly increments attempts counter ✓
test_credentials: Ephemeral users created per test via /api/auth/register with prefix `test_pw_e2e_` / `test_fp_`; cleaned up after each test class.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test uses direct MongoDB injection into `password_resets` collection with a known bcrypt-hashed OTP to bypass real email delivery for happy-path verification. All injected records and users cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_forgot_password.py — run with `pytest -n 0` (pytest.ini enforces xdist loadscope). For happy-path E2E we inject OTP directly into MongoDB collection `password_resets` using bcrypt.hashpw because backend never returns plaintext OTP (correct). If retesting, note that hitting /api/auth/forgot-password will overwrite/invalidate any manually injected OTP — always re-inject AFTER submitting step 1. Frontend `/lupa-sandi` route now works after adding the missing import. E2E fully verified: reset → toast success → redirect to /masuk → login with new password succeeds (200), old fails (401).
rca of the issue: Root cause of the SPA crash risk: main agent added the /lupa-sandi Route element and created the ForgotPasswordPage component but forgot to add the corresponding ES module import in App.js. Reproduction: navigate to /masuk → React attempts to render the app tree containing a JSX reference to `ForgotPasswordPage` (an undefined identifier) → ReferenceError. Mitigation applied: added `import ForgotPasswordPage from "@/pages/ForgotPasswordPage";` to App.js. Verified: /masuk loads, /lupa-sandi loads, full reset flow works.
